description: Implementation of the ContextNULL class and related null renderer components for ANGLE project, providing a stub backend that simulates OpenGL context behavior without actual rendering.

classes.name: AllocationTrackerNULL
classes.description: Tracks memory allocations for the null renderer, ensuring total allocated bytes do not exceed a maximum limit.

classes.name: ContextNULL
classes.description: A stub implementation of an OpenGL context that performs no actual rendering but provides the necessary interface for testing or fallback purposes.

methods.name: updateMemoryAllocation
methods.description: Updates the total allocated memory, ensuring no overflow or exceeding maximum limit.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the null context, always returns continue.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes commands, no operation, returns continue.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Finishes commands, no operation, returns continue.

methods.name: drawArrays
methods.description: Stub for drawing arrays, returns continue.

methods.name: drawElements
methods.description: Stub for drawing elements, returns continue.

methods.name: stencilFillPath
methods.description: Stub for stencil fill path, no operation.

methods.name: onMakeCurrent
methods.description: Stub for making context current, returns continue.

methods.name: createPaths
methods.description: Creates a vector of PathNULL instances.
